grammar.label: adjective + preposition collocations
grammar.form: interested in, afraid of, good at, keen on
grammar.meaning: fixed preposition after a particular adjective

explanation.en: Each adjective takes a fixed preposition and must be learned as a pair. A verb after the preposition takes -ing.
explanation.uz: Har bir sifat o'ziga xos predlog bilan keladi va juftlik sifatida yodlanadi. Predlogdan keyin fe'l -ing shaklida bo'ladi.

grammar.positive_example: She is good at explaining things.
grammar.negative_example: She is good in explain things.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbekcha kelishik qo'shimchalari ingliz predloglariga bir-biriga to'g'ri kelmaydi.

grammar.label: verb + preposition collocations
grammar.form: depend on, apply for, complain about, belong to
grammar.meaning: fixed preposition after a particular verb

explanation.en: Like adjectives, many verbs take a fixed preposition. Learn the verb and its preposition together.
explanation.uz: Sifatlar kabi ko'p fe'llar ham qat'iy predlog bilan keladi. Fe'lni predlogi bilan birga yodlang.

l1_notes.uz: 'discuss' va 'enter' predlogsiz keladi; o'quvchi ularga predlog qo'shib yuboradi.

body.text: Tell me what you are good at.

body.text: I am good at explaining difficult things clearly.

body.text: That is a useful ability here. And what interests you?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: I have always been interested in how systems work.

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: It changes with the project, I think.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: It does. What are you afraid of in a job like this?

body.speaker: Aziz
body.text: Being stuck. I am not afraid of hard work.

body.speaker: Mr Karimov
body.text: Good. Nobody here complains about the hours.

body.text: May I ask what you look for in a candidate?
